source: localAgentTurnRunner.test.ts › ends the turn when the engine stops mid-answer, instead of waiting forever
localAgentTurnRunner.test.ts › drops an engine-settled request from the registry, not just from the turn (ask shape)
description: The engine stops while the agent is mid-answer and parked on a permission ask: agentTurn/index.ts calls bus.shutdown() on any non-running engine state, every listener gets onClosed, and the turn ends as an error. Hand-written rather than recorded: a real restart needs a live credential and a turn long enough to kill under, and nothing in the runner reads anything the fake does not send.
_phase2_note: Phase 2 moved the wiring the description names: the engine-stopped hook that calls bus.shutdown() now lives in src/main/agents/drivers/index.ts, and services/agentTurn/index.ts is gone. The step script is unchanged.
